card.name: Small words inside practical how-to instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words (and, using, not, is, kept) in the middle of practical safety or gardening instructions. Mostly bullet-style advice on electrical equipment or handling plants.

modes.label: Electrical safety bullets
modes.description: Linking words inside bullet advice on cables, plugs and faulty equipment.
modes.example: - suspect or faulty equipment is taken out of use, labelled 'DO NOT USE'<< and>> kept secure until examined by a competent person

modes.label: Gardening advice
modes.description: Linking or verb words in tips on handling bulbs, seed and plants.
modes.example: in soil or in the rock garden it is always advisable to do so with a trowel, never with a dibber. If a dibber<< is>> used an air pocket may be left below
